items.title: Nikon microscopic video competition winner disqualified for using generative AI
items.rationale: A real decision. Nikon stripped a winning video of its prize for undisclosed generative AI and is now rewriting the contest rules, a concrete case of AI provenance enforcement for moving-image competitions.
items.excerpt: Nikon says it’s revisiting its competition rules after the original winner’s video was too good to be true.

items.title: Did Royal Mail Revive BBC & 'Paddington' Voiceover Star With AI?
items.rationale: A new voice-likeness dispute. The daughter of late voiceover artist Paul Vaughan accuses the Royal Mail Christmas ad of recreating his voice with AI, raising the consent question for posthumous voice cloning.
items.excerpt: Daughter of Paul Vaughan, an acclaimed BBC and 'Paddington' voiceover artist, accuses Royal Mail Christmas ad of resurrecting her father using AI.

items.title: AI-Produced Series ‘Space Nation’ and ‘Kira’ to Premiere Pilot Episodes at Mipcom (EXCLUSIVE)
items.rationale: A concrete market event. Two generative-AI sci-fi series will world-premiere their pilots at Mipcom, putting AI-produced TV in front of international buyers.
items.excerpt: Two science-fiction series produced with generative AI, 'Space Nation' and 'Kira,' will have the world premieres of their pilot episodes at Mipcom.

items.title: AI-Assisted Animated K-Drama ‘The Painted Soul’ From ‘Mouse’ Director Sets Rakuten Viki Launch (EXCLUSIVE)
items.rationale: A dated global release. An established K-drama director's AI-assisted animated series launches on Rakuten Viki on Oct. 21, so AI animation is reaching mainstream streaming distribution.
items.excerpt: ‘Mouse’ director Choi Junbae’s AI-assisted animated K-drama ‘The Painted Soul’ launches on Rakuten Viki Oct. 21 in key global markets.

items.title: Danny Boyle Shares Why He Used AI for Maggie Thatcher in ‘Ink’ – Without Asking Her Estate and His Love for ‘Obsession’ and ‘Backrooms’
items.rationale: A major director explains a specific AI choice: he recreated Margaret Thatcher in 'Ink' without the estate's consent. It is a concrete marker for AI likeness of real people in prestige film.
items.excerpt: During a London Film Festival chat, the filmmaker also recalled his “uneventful” meeting with Rupert Murdoch after his ‘Slumdog Millionaire’ made the mogul’s studio “a lot of money.”
